title: Senior Monday
description: Senior Monday Mondays are for our 60+ visitors! Enjoy $10 admission and a free coffee or tea while you explore. Already a member? Your coffee or tea is on us! Start your week with discovery, community, and a warm cup. (Offer not available on stat holidays)

title: Line Dancing – Monday
description: Come and enjoy some line dancing with our energetic and fun loving seniors. You will learn some new patterns every week, or practice the ones you already know and get some great exercise. Great fun is had by all.

title: LEGOtime!
venue: PG Public Library — Bob Harkins Branch
description: We have LEGO! Meet with other builders for some creative fun.*Excluding Mon, May, 18 (Victoria Day) and Mon, June 1 (Staff Development Day)

title: Yoga in the Orchard
description: Join the always-sunny Rachelle from Sunset Studio for a relaxing, beginner-friendly yoga class in our Orchard! Booking starts June. Classes run every Monday from June to August and will take place outside in our riverside events area. Each ticket includes a glass of wine to be enjoyed before, during, or after your class.
